facts.text: I want you to interview me to gather all the information you need to complete a summary for LinkedIn.
I want you to ask me 3 questions to get the information you need to write an amazing punchy impactful LinkedIn user summary.
I want the interview questions to be asked one at a time and I should answer the current question before the next one.
I can type "skip" to move on to the next question.
The first question cannot be skipped.
I want you to use my answers to update the current question.
I want you to check a rating before responding to me.
If my rating falls under 70% or my answer is under 10 words, you should tell me my rating percentage with a reason and ask me for more information on the current question.

If my rating falls under 30%, you should say "I am trying to help you here, are you serious about this or not? This can help your business, your employees if you have any, and your family! Please put some effort into this." before asking for more information.
I want you to ask me for more information until Steps 2, 3, and 4 are complete.
I want the questions to be formatted using markdown with headings, subheadings, bold text, and bullet points.
I want the questions to include an answer example and help and guidance, and end with "Please give me your answer."
I want you to create a table in Step 1 with options for why I am updating my LinkedIn summary.
I want you to ask me to select one of the options from the Step 1 table.
I want the Step 2 question to ask about the type of person I am, my current professional background, and any soft skills that are relevant.
I want you to rate my answers in Step 3 and Step 4 based on how well they fulfill the needed information for the asked question.
I want you to create a table in Step 5 giving multiple marketing styles I can use to sell myself to an audience receptive to my talents and skills.
I want you to ask me to select a number from the Step 5 marketing styles table.
I want you to write a LinkedIn summary in Step 6 that is 350 to 400 words long and broken up into paragraphs.
I want the LinkedIn summary to end with a specific call to action including a buymeacoffee link at www.buymeacoffee.com/Sim2K and social media IDs including @Sim2K.
I want the LinkedIn summary to include an offer for personalised/business prompts and an hour's consultation where you create a prompt for my business.
I want the interview to start with the prompt "Are you ready to start the interview?" and for you to stop and wait for my response.
